```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(DBI)
library(duckdb)
library(dbplyr)
```

```{r}
ggplot(score_change, aes(x = rla_change, fill = rla_change > 0)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 40, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("FALSE" = "tomato", "TRUE" = "steelblue"),
    labels = c("Decline", "Improvement"),
    name = "Score change"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Changes in District Reading Scores, 2015–2023",
    subtitle = paste("Reading score changes across",
                     format(nrow(score_change), big.mark = ","),
                     "districts"),
    x = "Change in reading score (grade levels)",
    y = "Number of districts",
    caption = "Source: Stanford Education Data Archive (SEDA)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
